time_origin: t=0 exactly inherits original static positions, requests, labels and channel values.
interval_semantics: Frame t records position/channel at t and movement during (t-10,t]; frame zero has zero distance/speed.
static_selection: first 30 rows in original source order, matching the static paper experiment
movement_model: Correlated random walk with full-segment building avoidance; 40-80 s moving / 20-40 s pauses for intermittent users.
profile_assignment: Building-contained source users are static. Among remaining users, seeded ID ranking selects exactly 10 intermittent and 10 continuous users; others are static.
bounds_policy: Preserve existing bounds except sides excluding source coordinates; extend those sides 5 m past the outermost source point.
channel_model: Per-user legacy-static channel anchor plus the existing deterministic geometric model increments.
user_identity: Persistent (Scenario,RX_ID); source ID, X/Y/Z at t=0, request and label preserved.
limitations: The legacy north CSV is internally SNR/CQI-consistent but cannot be reproduced at its source coordinates by the supplied current map/code settings; 17/30 CQI values differ before anchoring. Historical cause is not established.
The per-user static offset is a continuity calibration. It preserves model-predicted changes along the existing path, not independently measured future channel values.
The original static SNR/RX noise-floor rounding is preserved. SNR and RX are independently anchored to avoid changing any static channel field.
Four original building-contained receivers remain stationary; inherited geometry is not a calibrated indoor propagation model.
Source movement validation applies because positions, IDs, profiles, schedules and distance/speed fields are unchanged.
This dataset does not itself execute a dynamic control experiment.

channel_anchor.cqi_formula: round(1 + ((clamp(SNR_anchor,-10,30) + 10) / 40) * 14), Python round, matching upstream function
channel_anchor.scope: All 90 users, all 31 frames. Fixed per-user offset; no artificial first-step channel switch.
channel_anchor.signal_precision: Decimal arithmetic on the existing 6-decimal raw timeline and original 2-decimal static values; exact original channel text at t0 and for stationary users.
channel_anchor.los_semantics: LOS at t0 and for stationary users is the original static LOS; at later nonstationary-profile frames it is current geometry LOS. raw_model_los always records current geometry, and exported_los_origin identifies provenance. Anchored SNR is not claimed to be a fresh uncalibrated path-loss prediction from exported LOS.
channel_anchor.dynamic_state_allocation: No allocation/admission/classification chosen or changed by this dataset generator.
